summary: Frontend-only Final Review & Freeze QA pass on INHEIRA. Logged in as test@songright.com and walked every route: /, /auth, /dashboard, /sessions, /sessions/new, /sessions/:id (redirect), /sessions/:id/studio, /sessions/:id/dna, /sessions/:id/release, /sessions/:id/intelligence, /sessions/:id/split-sheet, /writing-rooms, /creator/user_seed_test001, /profile, /vaulta, /settings/integrations, plus mobile 375x812. Overall the platform PASSES the freeze walkthrough for the critical must-flag categories: no user-facing 'Songright' text, no '1 collaborators' grammar bug (singular/plural is correct: '1 CREATOR' / '2 CREATORS'), /sessions/:id correctly redirects to /studio, all 11 Release-Path stages render, SongDNA eyebrow + 'CONTINUE TO RELEASE PATH' cross-link present, Landing 'POWERED BY ANCR' footer present, Vaulta hero + GMR tile present, Writing Rooms shows all 6 cities (Atlanta rendered as uppercase 'ATLANTA'), all spot-check test IDs resolve (under their actual names in constants). Two real must-fix items remain: residual violet-300/400/500 from the SONGRIGHT era in StudioSession + SongIntelligence + the Life-of-Song progress gradient, and Dashboard horizontal-scroll overflow at 375px caused by the Life-of-Song 10-stage strip not being overflow-x-scroll on mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: Active-chapter left rail item and multiple section eyebrows/buttons still use bg-violet-500/10, text-violet-400, border-violet-500, bg-violet-500 (see StudioSession.jsx lines 223, 574–581, 607, 615, 626, 645, 679, 748–825, 905, 1050, 1067, 1111–1117, 1134, 1197, 1271–1305, 1344–1380, 1413, 1432, 1453, 1503–1582). Renders 5 violet-400/500 classes (tab pill selected state + card border/bg). Task requires no visible violet color drift on /intelligence.

ui_bugs.component: Life-of-Song progress-bar gradient (used in Dashboard, Studio, Release Path)
ui_bugs.issue: Gradient bar uses `bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-300 via-indigo-300 to-violet-300` — the `to-violet-300` stop violates the palette freeze (should end in indigo or sky). Appears 3x on /dashboard, 3x on /studio, 6x on /release.

Horizontal scroll on the whole page: document.scrollWidth = 484px on 375px viewport (~109px overflow). Root cause: the Life-of-Song 10-stage node strip (10 nodes × ~60px + gaps) renders wider than the viewport and is not wrapped in an overflow-x-auto container, so it stretches its parent. Mobile Studio does NOT overflow, so the Studio version is scrollable — apply the same pattern to Dashboard.

ui_bugs.component: Studio chapter sub-tab strip (Write / Release chapters)
ui_bugs.issue: After clicking [data-testid=studio-chapter-write] only the 'Lyrics' section renders — 'Melody', 'Chords', 'Arrangement' sub-tab labels are not visible in the DOM text (task expects all four as sub-tabs). Same for [data-testid=studio-chapter-release]: only 'Publishing' visible, 'Rights' and 'Analytics' sub-tabs are missing from the rendered strip. Either the sub-tab labels have been renamed or the strip only shows the active panel body. PLEASE VERIFY intended behaviour.
'Next payout ~90 days' chip described in review is NOT present on /vaulta — the string 'payout' appears elsewhere but the '~90 days' hint is absent. Cosmetic gap, please confirm intended copy.

issues: 'every dollar' correctly uses sky/indigo gradient (no violet-300 hit on Vaulta) — palette OK here.
City labels are uppercased (ATLANTA, NASHVILLE, LONDON, LAGOS, TOKYO, KINGSTON) — matches design system. All 6 rooms rendering.

observations_only: Test-ID naming drift between review checklist and code constants (not broken, just different names): review lists `session-list-root` → code uses `sessions-list-root`; review lists `creator-passport-root` → code uses `passport-root`; review lists `release-root` → code uses `release-dashboard-root`. All three roots DO render in the DOM under their actual names, so this is a documentation drift, not a bug. Recommend syncing the freeze checklist to constants/testIds/phase2.js.
`studio-insights` and `studio-chat-send` testids exist in code but are inside specific chapter panels — they only appear when their chapter is active (Idea overview / Collaborate chat). Not a bug.

AuthPage split-screen renders 'Where creativity becomes\nlegacy.' (with a newline between 'becomes' and 'legacy.') — visually correct in screenshot, just multi-line so substring 'creativity becomes legacy' won't match against innerText.
Landing page has 'POWERED BY ANCR™' footer ✅ and NO 'Songright' text anywhere user-facing ✅.
Sessions list singular/plural grammar is CORRECT ('1 CREATOR' vs '2 CREATORS') — no '1 collaborators' bug.
/sessions/:id redirect to /studio confirmed (no page render on old URL).

All 11 Release-Path stages render in order: Creative Evidence™, RightsPrint™, Ownership, Split Sheet, Publishing, Vaulta™, Song Intelligence™, Commercial Readiness, Release Readiness, Distribution, Life of a Song™.
SongDNA page shows 'SONG DNA™ · IMMUTABLE HISTORY · 67FB26' eyebrow + 'CONTINUE TO RELEASE PATH' cross-link ✅.
Creator DNA `/creator/user_seed_test001` renders passport-root + passport-header + passport-discography test IDs.

Localstorage token key is still `songright_token` (internal, not user-facing) — safe to keep for backward compatibility of existing sessions but a future migration to `inheira_token` would be cleaner.
Mobile Studio (/studio at 375px) does NOT horizontally scroll ✅ — model to copy for Dashboard.

Optional: add the 'Next payout ~90 days' hint chip on the Vaulta Estimated Earnings card (referenced in review, not in DOM).

Palette lint: add a simple grep-based check to CI: `grep -rEl 'violet-(300|400|500|600)' src/` and fail if non-empty — would have caught this before freeze.

rca_of_the_issue: Palette freeze was applied to most surfaces (Sessions, Vaulta, Profile, Creator DNA, Integrations, SplitSheet, SongDNA, Writing Rooms are all violet-free at runtime) but StudioSession.jsx and SongIntelligence.jsx were not touched, and a shared Life-of-Song progress gradient still ends in `to-violet-300` — that gradient is rendered on every page that shows the 10-stage spine (Dashboard, Studio, Release), so a single class change eliminates the majority of remaining violet hits. Mobile /dashboard overflow is caused by the Life-of-Song 10-stage node row lacking overflow-x-auto on the mobile breakpoint — Studio already does this correctly.
